name: @mad-council-claw/desktop-shell
description: Electron desktop shell for MAD Council Claw - hosts the engine-core runtime and renderer UI. F-032 ships the createMainWindow descriptor + window-state resolution helpers; F-033 ships the chat-history-pane descriptor; F-034 ships the info-panel descriptor; subsequent M5 features (F-035..F-043) add IPC handlers, BrowserWindow lifecycle wiring, and electron-builder packaging.
